text:
maria: small-scope rollout proposal: tenant opt-in compact fallback for latency/cost spikes. Plan: tiny internal canary, opt-in pilots, automated degrade on SLO/quality triggers. Looking for owners and minimal timeline.

samir: router change required: per-request flag eval + header x-rw-fallback. effort ~3w runtime + 1w telemetry. compact variant saves ~25-30% CPU.

devon: SRE: need circuit breaker. trigger if p99 > 2x SLO for 10m OR error-rate > 3x baseline. Action: flip affected tenant/region to compact variant and page PO + on-call. Ramp suggestion: 0.5% internal -> pilot opt-in -> hold 24h. Auto-rollback on error budget burn or quality drop.

lea: CS: two pilots want opt-in (FinCo, HealthCo). HealthCo requires EU-only processing for pilot. Need per-tenant kill-switch in console and request-level logs for validation.

carl: eng-platform can provision isolated EU pool for HealthCo. ETA ~6 business days. Will add tenant logs.

jia: telemetry: need token-cost delta, latency p50/95/99, and embedding-similarity for A/B samples. Runtime should support shadowing outputs for diffs.

maria: decision checklist: runtime flag (samir), EU pool (carl), runbook (devon), pilot prompts/legal (lea), telemetry dashboards (jia). Minimal timeline: internal canary in 1 week, pilots in 3 weeks. Opt-in first preferred to limit blast radius. Sync Fri 11am.
